issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): int (Problem statement UML lines 70-72), but the template comments and the provided solution implement/getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor as double (template comment indicates "Return type: double for precise calculation" and the solution method signature returns double). This inconsistency can confuse students about the expected return type and lead to implementations that do not match the solution or tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the expected return type consistent across all artifacts. Either update the UML and any problem text to specify getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double (preferred for precision) or change the template comment and solution to return int. Ensure the UML, template comments, and solution all use the same return type and update tests/instructions accordingly.
